# TASK-020 — Mid-year school onboarding and opening balances

**Domain:** Fees / Onboarding · **Technical prerequisites:** TASK-013, TASK-019 · **Policy gate:** SCOPE_CONFIRMATION · **Review:** **HIGH** · **Only execution tracker:** [TASK-TRACKER.md](../TASK-TRACKER.md)

## 1. Functional requirements and exact use cases
**User story:** The school can mid-year school onboarding and opening balances.

**Source acceptance examples:** UC1: 300 students imported on 2026-08-01; their June–July dues are optionally imported as opening debt, not generated by current tuition rule. UC2: previously paid June receipt exists externally; import as provenance only, no fresh system receipt falsely attributed. UC3: multiple same ledger rows in workbook rejected with line-level errors. UC4: preview totals match source and import commits once. UC5: rollback corrects batch with auditable adjustment, no hard delete.

**Required business policy and constraints:** Opening balances must not be generated automatically from guessed school fees. Client chooses whether migration contains outstanding balance only or full receipt history, whether previous period paid amounts are trusted, reconciliation signoff and adjustment permissions. Every entry carries source metadata, as-of date, importedBy and original reference. If scope not approved, task BLOCKED.

**Primary golden example:** Import school midyear with 300 students including old June arrears and original paid proof, no double charge or fake SaaS payment, rerun same batch results no duplicates. Confirm any school-level policy in [DECISIONS.md](../DECISIONS.md) before implementation; do not treat examples as approval for a new penalty, charge or write-off.

## 2. Detailed database/domain DLD
**Existing files and interfaces to inspect in latest stable main:** `apps/api/src/modules/students/application/student-import.service.ts`<br>`apps/api/src/modules/fees/repository/fees.repository.ts`<br>`apps/api/src/platform/files/private-file.service.ts`

**Proposed schema evolution:** MigrationBatch(id,schoolId,academicSessionId,asOfDate,sourceSystem,sourceFileId,checksum,status,previewTotals,importedBy,reviewedBy,createdAt,committedAt) and MigrationRow(batchId,rowIndex,studentId,category,period,openingOutstanding,externallyPaid?,reference,rowHash,status,error). FeeCharge.source=OPENING_BALANCE with unique schoolId+batchId+rowHash, and optional HistoricalExternalPayment reference that is excluded from SaaS collection charts unless client approves reporting semantics.

**Precise model and ownership decisions:**
1. Create MigrationBatch with sourceFile, checksum, asOf DATE, actor, preview totals, reviewer, status and row-level errors; opening FeeCharge source type separate from ordinary assessed tuition.
2. Read private XLSX with streaming/bounds, normalize matched student ID/code but never auto-merge uncertain matches. Differentiate historical **external paid** proof from new app cash collection and original school receipt.

**Mandatory data migration:** prepare disposable test DB with two schools, previous school fees, paid/partial/void records, receipt numbers, historical student class and TC snapshots. Apply additive nullable/new-table migration; run deterministic idempotent mapping; verify **zero discrepancy in posted money**, no old ID/receipt/file changes, no invalid cross-school FK, tested resume/rollback. Existing `FeeDue`/single-payment compatibility persists until approved cutover; no new aggregate may accidentally double count old and new shadows. A financial reversal is an audited event rather than dropping already-written new production data.

## 3. Detailed API/DTO and guard DLD
**Task contract proposal:** POST /operator/onboarding/opening-balances/upload XLSX private; GET /operator/onboarding/opening-balances/:id/validation; POST /operator/onboarding/opening-balances/:id/preview; POST /operator/onboarding/opening-balances/:id/commit {checksum,expectedTotals,idempotencyKey}; GET /operator/onboarding/opening-balances/:id/results. Do not let imported sheet supply arbitrary schoolId or force a SaaS receiptNumber.

**Validation and response:** Request via Zod typed contracts; server actor determines school; category/rule/charge IDs validated same-school before work. Money `NUMERIC(12,2)`/Decimal (avoid `Number()` for financial posting), business DATE school-local. Mutations require MANAGER plus CSRF/audit, immutable idempotency key with request hash, version or row lock, 409 on stale/overpay/invalid state, 422 malformed money/dates, 403 viewer, 404 foreign tenant, 503 recoverable queue/storage. Preserve legacy route/method/request/response or provide explicit adapter + regression test.

**Cross-module HTTP and public facade behavior:** Read private XLSX with streaming/bounds, normalize matched student ID/code but never auto-merge uncertain matches. Differentiate historical **external paid** proof from new app cash collection and original school receipt. All fees mutations and document clearance use the Fees-owned StudentFeeAccount lock/revision boundary; document issue never queries private fee repositories.

## 4. Service algorithm & frontend UI design
**Implementation and user journey sequence:**
1. Read private XLSX with streaming/bounds, normalize matched student ID/code but never auto-merge uncertain matches. Differentiate historical **external paid** proof from new app cash collection and original school receipt.
2. Preview rows and before/after per-school totals, require checksum/signoff and idempotencyKey. Commit in bounded restartable chunks using Fees facade StudentFeeAccount locks and sourceKey uniqueness.
3. UI wizard Upload → Match Students → Review opening totals/duplicates → Confirm → Import progress → Error XLSX and audit; no invented receipt number for external payment.
4. Import school midyear with 300 students including old June arrears and original paid proof, no double charge or fake SaaS payment, rerun same batch results no duplicates.

**Existing service flow from the requested requirements:** Use existing private file store and versioned XLSX parser; normalize student via matched ID/SR + full-name warnings (do not auto-merge uncertain matches); validate decimals/date/categories and duplicate source references; compute before/after ledger diff and require second confirmation; commit in bounded chunks via job/outbox, preserve error rows; only Fees owner posts balances. UI wizard Upload → Validate → Match → Preview → Confirm → Results with clear school-wise reconcile totals.

**Failure, retry and race behavior:** Potential legacy student-code collision needs operator review, not merge; imported cash already received must not be counted again as a payment; adding existing debts and back-billing rule simultaneously must not double charge. Allow migrating without Aadhaar.

**UI contract:** show school/current year where applicable, selected student/fee type/period and due/paid/outstanding with human-readable source month. On any mutation, show confirmation/preview before writing, loading and duplicate-click prevention, recoverable errors, final server-sourced totals and links to existing payment history. Support 360px mobile, 768px tablet, 1366px desktop, keyboard/labels and A4 print where used. No dead buttons or changes to unrelated navigation.

**NFR/performance/security tests:** TASK-020-NFR01 normal and invalid school scenarios; TASK-020-NFR02 tenant/role and legacy regression; TASK-020-NFR03 concurrency or load as applicable.

**Mandatory adversarial tests:** school B charge/student UUID via school A; report viewer direct write; valid CSRF but wrong role; simultaneous pay/void on same account; imported duplicate records; timezone March–April boundary; job interruption/replay; zero balance after approved exemption; snapshot immutability after rule/class/name change. Apply tests relevant to this task and record others as N/A with reason. No mock-only green check marks: use isolated Postgres, web browser and queue where changed.

**Protected old journeys:** BASE-06,08,09,10,11,12; compare before/after using [REGRESSION-BASELINE.md](../REGRESSION-BASELINE.md), retaining all existing fee setup/generation, student admissions/imports, transport, dashboard pending XLSX, payment/void, receipts and platform TC as relevant.

## 6. Migration cutover and Done
Stage `schema expand → compatibility read → shadow backfill → amounts/IDs reconcile → controlled writer enablement → live reconciliation → documented safe roll-forward/recovery`. A rewrite is permitted but old UI/API functionality remains working until any deliberate replacement is reviewed. Record SQL/index EXPLAIN, 500/5000-student baseline p50/p95, real signed TEST outputs, screenshots at 3 widths, paired school fixtures, immutable old receipt/TC hashes, reviewer signoff in the [single tracker](../TASK-TRACKER.md). **Do not mark DONE before reviewed merge.**
